# Base64 tools

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Built-in tools and hand-off · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

src/ui/tools.ts `toBase64`/`fromBase64`, file encode up to 20 MiB

## What is missing

URL-safe and MIME output, padding/line-length options; strict mode with error offsets; text-encoding choice; data: URL build/parse; streaming with progress and SHA-256 check; file drop round trip (`name.ext.base64.txt`); decode to file with preview; history/undo; site
